# TEN BROTHERS TRADING LIMITED (TBTL)

> Trusted supplier of hardware and building materials in Tanzania, based in Dar es Salaam. We sell cement, steel, roofing, plumbing, electrical, paint and tools at wholesale prices with fast delivery across the country. Website is bilingual (English and Kiswahili).

## Key facts
- Business: TEN BROTHERS TRADING LIMITED (TBTL)
- Location: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- Serves: Dar es Salaam, Dodoma, Arusha, Mwanza, and Tanzania nationwide
- Website: https://tbtltz.com
- Contact: phone +255 752 122 255, email admin@tbtltz.com, WhatsApp +255 752 122 255
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00-18:00 (EAT)
- Languages: English, Kiswahili
- Currency: Tanzanian Shilling (TZS)

## Product categories
- Cement & Aggregates (saruji na kokoto)
- Steel & Rebar (chuma na nondo)
- Roofing (mabati na paa)
- Plumbing (mabomba na maji)
- Electrical (umeme)
- Paint & Finishing (rangi na umaliziaji)
- Tools & Hardware (zana na hardware)
